why: Searches turn up 2024-2026 progress on weaker/adjacent statements (infinitude of palindromic almost-primes with bounded prime factors, infinitude of square-free palindromes) but explicit statements that the palindromic-prime infinitude conjecture itself remains open and out of reach with current methods.
queries: palindromic primes every base infinitely many proof 2025

found.title: Infinitude of palindromic almost-prime numbers
found.note: Proves infinitude of palindromes with at most six prime factors in any base, not primes themselves.

found.title: The infinitude of square-free palindromes
found.note: Proves infinitude of square-free palindromes in base b, a different (weaker) statement than palindromic primes.

found.title: Palindromic prime
found.note: Article states it is unknown whether there are infinitely many palindromic primes in base 10; conjecture described as unsolved.
